items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: I was with Woody because Shorty Rogers ... trumpet player. ... So I joined Woody Herman just for that stint.

ctx.x: Yeah. That’s all I remember. I was with Woody because Shorty Rogers — was that his name — trumpet player. He was in the service. So he was going to get out of the service, so his chair — Neal Hefti had his chair. But Neal Hefti was arranging and wanted to just write. But Neal played trumpet see? So he saw me, and I was in between bands, and he says, “Jack, you want to play with Woody Herman until Shorty gets out of the service?” He says, “I’m doing the chair right now and I don’t want to, I’ve got a lot of…
Was that “the first herd” they call it?
